solution: Omar brought the node back and the cache came up a few minutes later.
short_description: Checkout page slowed to a crawl due to missing cache pod after kernel maintenance.
trigger: A customer complained on social media
problem_statement: Tuesday night the checkout page slowed to a crawl for about twenty minutes because the cache pod had been moved during the kernel maintenance and never came back, causing orders-api to read everything straight from the database.
impact_description: The checkout page slowed to a crawl.
customer_feedback: A customer complained on social media.
immediate_resolution: Omar brought the node back and the cache came up a few minutes later.
root_causes: The cache pod had been moved during the kernel maintenance and never came back.
There is no alert on the cache itself.
